scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: vitest run test/device-settings.test.ts test/model-initialization.test.ts test/attachments.test.ts test/workspace-files.test.ts test/desk-view.test.ts test/native-session-context.test.ts test/workspace-reader-integration.test.tsx test/workspace-turn-context.test.ts
scripts.test:unit: tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.test.json && vitest run --passWithNoTests --exclude test/device-settings.test.ts --exclude test/model-initialization.test.ts --exclude test/attachments.test.ts --exclude test/workspace-files.test.ts --exclude test/desk-view.test.ts --exclude test/native-session-context.test.ts --exclude test/workspace-reader-integration.test.tsx --exclude test/workspace-turn-context.test.ts
